live.what_is_live: Vessel names, IMO/MMSI, dimensions, deadweight, reported draught, navigation status and area, last port and departure time, carrier ETA/ETD. Tide and sun times.
live.what_is_not_live: Latitude/longitude, speed and course are paywalled on every source reached and are NOT in this file. Container counts per vessel, berth assignments, yard inventory and crane status are not published and are estimated or assumed (see 'estimates').

sources.carrier_schedule: CNC / CMA CGM port schedule export for BDCGP, stamped Friday 13 November 2026 10:59
sources.ais_status: Maritime Optima public vessel pages and VesselFinder vessel pages, read 13 November 2026
sources.tides: tide-forecast.com, Chittagong, datum Mean Lower Low Water, read 13 November 2026
sources.cpa_tos: cpatos.gov.bd/tosdashboard snapshots dated June and October 2025 (stale; used only to calibrate boxes per call)

estimates.teu_capacity: deadweight / 14 (not published on the pages read)
estimates.moves_per_call: 0.85 x estimated TEU capacity, calibrated on import+export boxes per call in the 2025 CPA TOS snapshots
estimates.draught_used: reported draught capped at the 9.5 m standard limit; AIS draught is crew-entered and several values read were stale
